blocks.text: Chalti hui cheez mein ek aisi khoobi hoti hai jis ki wajah se woh har us cheez par force lagati hai jo use rokne ki koshish kare: cheez jitni tez chale use rokna utna mushkil, aur ek hi velocity se chalti do cheezon mein se zyada bhari ko rokna zyada mushkil hai. Newton ne is khoobi ko jism ki quantity of motion kaha; ab ise jism ka linear momentum p kehte hain.

blocks.title: Linear momentum
blocks.text: p = m v ... (2.25), jahan v mass m ki velocity hai. Linear momentum vector quantity hai jis ki simt velocity ki simt hai. Us ka SI unit kilogram metre per second (kg m s^-1) hai, jo newton second (N s) bhi likha ja sakta hai.
Momentum aur Newton ka doosra qanoon-e-harkat

Mass m ka jism ibtidai velocity vi se chalta hai; us par waqt t ke liye bahri force F lagti hai jis ke baad us ki velocity vf ho jati hai. Paida acceleration a = (vf - vi)/t hai, aur Newton ke doosre qanoon se a = F/m. Dono barabar rakh kar F/m = (vf - vi)/t, ya F x t = m vf - m vi ... (2.26), jahan m vi ibtidai momentum aur m vf aakhri momentum hai. Equation (2.26) dikhati hai ke momentum ki tabdeeli force aur us waqt ke hasil-e-zarb ke barabar hai jis ke liye woh lagi. Doosre qanoon ki yeh shakal F = ma se zyada aam hai, kyunke yeh un soorton tak barhai ja sakti hai jahan jism ke tez hote hue us ka mass bhi badle: rocket tez hote hue mass khota hai, kyunke us ka eendhan jal kar zyada dhakka dene ko bahar phenka jata hai. (2.26) se F = (m vf - m vi)/t, to doosra qanoon momentum ke zariye bhi bayan ho sakta hai: jism ke momentum ki tabdeeli ki waqt ke lihaz se raftar lagai gayi force ke barabar hai.

Kabhi lagai gayi force mustaqil nahi hoti aur bohat kam waqt ke liye lagti hai, jaise jab bat cricket ki gend ko marta hai aur takrao ke doran force lamha ba lamha badalti hai. Tab kisi ek miqdar ke bajaye force aur waqt ke hasil-e-zarb (F x t) se kaam lena zyada aasan hai. Waqt t mein lagne wali ausat force F ka hasil-e-zarb impulse kehlata hai: impulse = F x t = m vf - m vi ... (2.27).

blocks.title: Example 2.6
blocks.text: 1500 kg car ki velocity 3.0 s mein 20 m s^-1 se 15 m s^-1 ho jati hai. Ausat rokne wali force kitni thi? Hal: Eq. (2.27) se F x t = m vf - m vi, F x 3.0 s = 1500 kg x 15 m s^-1 - 1500 kg x 20 m s^-1, to F = -2500 kg m s^-2 = -2500 N = -2.5 kN. Manfi nishan batata hai ke force rokne wali hai.
Momentum ke baqa ka qanoon (law of conservation of momentum)

Isolated system woh hai jis par koi bahri agency koi force nahi lagati; maslan mustaqil darja hararat par sheeshe ke bartan mein band gas ke molecules isolated system hain: woh apni be-tarteeb harkat ki wajah se aapas mein takrate hain, magar sheeshe ke bartan mein band hone ki wajah se koi bahri agency un par force nahi laga sakti. Masses m1 aur m2 ki do chikni sakht tasur karti gendon ka isolated system lein jo ek hi seedhi lakeer mein ek hi simt mein velocities v1 aur v2 se chal rahi hain. Woh takrati hain, aur takrao ke baad m1 velocity v1' se aur m2 velocity v2' se usi simt mein chalti hai (Fig. 2.9). m1 ke momentum ki tabdeeli ke liye Eq. (2.27) se F x t = m1 v1' - m1 v1; isi tarah m2 ke liye F' x t = m2 v2' - m2 v2. Jama karne par (F + F') t = (m1 v1' - m1 v1) + (m2 v2' - m2 v2). Chunke action force F reaction force F' ke barabar aur ulat hai, F' = -F, ya F + F' = 0, to baen hissa sifr hai: 0 = (m1 v1' - m1 v1) + (m2 v2' - m2 v2). Doosre lafzon mein pehli gend ke momentum ki tabdeeli jama doosri gend ke momentum ki tabdeeli sifr hai, ya m1 v1 + m2 v2 = m1 v1' + m2 v2' ... (2.28): takrao se pehle system ka kul ibtidai momentum takrao ke baad kul aakhri momentum ke barabar hai, to isolated do-gend system ke momentum ki kul tabdeeli sifr hai.

blocks.alt: Teen marhale, har ek neeche aur daen taraf. Pehle gendein m1 aur m2 velocities v1 aur v2 se daen taraf chalti hain. Phir gendein chhoti hain: m1 par force F' baen taraf aur m2 par F daen taraf. Aakhir mein woh velocities v'1 aur v'2 se daen taraf alag hoti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.9: Takrao se pehle, dauran aur baad do gendein (kitab ki Figure 2.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Cheezon ke aise group ke liye, agar group ke andar koi cheez force mehsoos kare to usi group ki kisi aur cheez par barabar magar ulti reaction force honi chahiye; nateejatan poore group ke momentum ki tabdeeli hamesha sifr hai. Yeh momentum ke baqa ka qanoon hai: isolated system ka kul linear momentum mustaqil rehta hai. Qanoon lagate waqt yaad rakhein ke jism ka momentum vector quantity hai.

blocks.title: Example 2.7
blocks.text: 2.0 kg aur 3.0 kg ki do gol gendein 6.0 m s^-1 aur 4 m s^-1 ki velocities se ek doosre ki taraf chal rahi hain. Takrao ke baad chhoti gend ki velocity kya hogi agar bari gend ki velocity 3.0 m s^-1 ho? Hal: chunke gendein ek doosre ki taraf chalti hain, un ki velocities ke nishan ulte hain; 2 kg gend ki simt musbat aur 3 kg ki manfi lein. Takrao se pehle momentum: m1 v1 + m2 v2 = 2 kg x 6 m s^-1 + 3 kg x (-4 m s^-1) = 12 kg m s^-1 - 12 kg m s^-1 = 0. Baad mein: m1 v1' + m2 v2' = 2 kg x v1' + 3 kg x (-3) m s^-1. Baqa se 0 = 2 kg x v1' - 9 kg m s^-1, to v1' = 4.5 m s^-1.

blocks.caption: Side boxes
rows: kaun sa zyada dukhta hai, patthar ko thokar (raabta 1/100 s) ya football ko (1/10 s), aur kyun; kya chalti cheez mein impulse hota hai?
baal khopri par crumple zone ka kaam karte hain: nangi khopri taqreeban 5 N se toot sakti hai, magar jild aur baalon ke saath taqreeban 50 N chahiye
jab car jaldi rukti hai to musafir windshield ki taraf aage jate hain; seatbelts harkat ki forces badal kar musafiron ko harkat se rokti hain, chot ka imkan bohat kam
motorcycle ka safety helmet is liye gaddedar hai ke kisi bhi takrao ka waqt barhaye aur sangeen chot se bachaye

blocks.prompt: 20 g ki gend squash court ki deewar se 0.50 s tak 50 N ki mustaqil force se takrati hai; impulse nikalein. Footballer 0.25 s tak 240 N ki ausat force lagata hai; momentum ki tabdeeli aur us ki simt nikalein (numerical problems 2.7, 2.8). Seatbelts aur helmets chot kyun ghatate hain?
blocks.explanation: Impulse = F x t = 50 N x 0.50 s = 25 N s (mass ki zaroorat nahi). Momentum ki tabdeeli = 240 N x 0.25 s = 60 N s = 60 kg m s^-1, lagai gayi force ki simt mein, jis simt gend ko thokar lagi. Helmet ki gaddi aur seatbelt us waqt ko lamba karte hain jis mein momentum badalta hai, to momentum ki ek jaisi tabdeeli ke liye ausat force F = (m vf - m vi)/t chhoti hoti hai.

items: p = mv (kg m s^-1 = N s), vector. F t = m vf - m vi: force = momentum ki tabdeeli ki raftar (F = ma se zyada aam, badalta mass sambhalti hai). Impulse = F t = momentum ki tabdeeli (Example 2.6: -2.5 kN).
Baqa: isolated system mein F' = -F, to m1 v1 + m2 v2 = m1 v1' + m2 v2'; isolated system ka kul linear momentum mustaqil rehta hai (vector majmooa). Example 2.7: v1' = 4.5 m s^-1.
